_readme: Fallback KB used ONLY when no oracle is available. Per category, a list of regexes matched against element ids (module.name / model::field / report_name). A match classifies a LOST STANDARD element as INTER_VERSION (an Odoo change) instead of UNKNOWN. Keep patterns SPECIFIC: an over-broad pattern can hide a real regression. This is a generic Odoo seed, NOT tied to any customer; extend it as triage confirms new inter-version changes. The oracle is the precise path; this is only the shortcut for well-known removals. The '*' key applies to every category.
_version_note: Anchor patterns with ^ / $ and escape dots. Group by the target major where the change lands when useful.
_model_renames_note: model_renames maps an OLD model name to its successor model in the target version (Odoo merges/renames). If the successor is present in MIGRATED, a disappeared OLD model is labelled RENAMED (verify data moved) instead of DATA_LOSS_RISK. If the successor is absent, it stays DATA_LOSS_RISK. Seed generic, version-specific renames here.
